header.title: Together we are building the journalism of the future!

intro.p1: We.Publish is far more than a technical solution. Together we form the strongest network of independent and innovative media.
intro.p2: With your investment in We.Publish you become part of a network that jointly invests in innovation, knowledge transfer and the advancement of journalism.
intro.p3: Your media organisation benefits directly too: through continuously improved infrastructure, new features, exchange with other publishers, as well as a growing and resilient media ecosystem.
intro.p4: Carried jointly by all media in the network and by the We.Publish foundation, which passes on all foundation funding directly to every network member.

contributionBar.label: Your contribution is indispensable - thank you for letting us count on you!
contributionBar.caption: Only together with you and {count} other independent media do we reach 100%!
